### Work on the Temple Ceases
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/work-on-the-temple-ceases
Passage: Ezra 4:24
Points:
- The initial return from Babylonian exile was only a modest beginning rather than full restoration.
- Compromised neighbors attempted to disrupt the reconstruction after their offer to participate was rejected.
- Persistent hostility from adversaries eventually brought the work on the temple to a standstill.
- Christians serving God and building His kingdom must anticipate sustained opposition from His enemies.
- Believers should stay alert to the enemy's schemes and pray that adverse plans fail.
